title: The ship-10x CLAUDE.md
blurb: A battle-tested CLAUDE.md: workflow orchestration, a self-improvement loop, verification gates and core principles.
body:
A CLAUDE.md template built for autonomous, high-quality output.

Workflow orchestration

  • Plan-mode default — enter plan mode for any non-trivial task (3+ steps); if something goes sideways, STOP and re-plan.
  • Subagent strategy — use subagents liberally to keep the main context clean; one task per subagent.
  • Self-improvement loop — after ANY correction, update tasks/lessons.md with the pattern; write rules to prevent the same mistake.
  • Verification before done — never mark complete without proving it works ("would a staff engineer approve this?").
  • Demand elegance (balanced) — for non-trivial changes, ask "is there a more elegant way?"; don't over-engineer simple fixes.
  • Autonomous bug fixing — given a bug report, just fix it; point at logs/errors/failing tests, then resolve.

Task management

Plan first (tasks/todo.md, checkable items) → verify plan → track progress → explain changes → document results → capture lessons (tasks/lessons.md).

Core principles

Simplicity first · No laziness (root causes, no temporary fixes) · Minimal impact (touch only what's necessary).

SOURCE · Basia Kubicka (AI PM @ LiquidMetal).
